repo_prior_art.cite: stat_neyman_regret_minimax concerns scalar superpopulation cumulative Neyman regret, not a whole-QTE anytime-band LIL converse.

published_prior_art.cite: HowardRamdas2022 gives i.i.d. quantile confidence sequences; SimchiLeviWang2024 concerns stochastic mean-gap welfare/power trade-offs.
LiLuoWangFeng2025 studies QTE-adaptive design, but no exact simultaneous two-quantile static regret--variance frontier was located.

repo_prior_art.cite: stat_neyman_regret_minimax is a scalar superpopulation regret converse and does not characterize the proposed QTE regret--LIL-width frontier.

published_prior_art.cite: NoarovFogliatoBertranRoth2025, SimchiLeviWang2024, and the quantile/CDF confidence-sequence papers address distinct scalar-regret, welfare/power, or inference coordinates.

soundness_flags.one_line: The condition is standard, but its cited bibliography record misidentifies Cook, Mishler, and Ramdas (2024) as AISTATS rather than CLeaR/PMLR 236; correct the citation.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Correct the Cook--Mishler--Ramdas venue throughout the bibliography and retain the overlap condition with a precise locator to the relevant propensity/positivity assumption.
Turn the frontier OEQ into a sharper field target by specifying one finite discretization regime and a quantitative regret-plus-width guarantee for the proposed primal--dual procedure.

Add a comparison theorem showing exactly how the QTE loading class reduces to the scalar ATE Neyman-regret benchmark, thereby making the strict extension beyond Dai--Gradu--Harshaw and Noarov--Fogliato--Bertran--Roth explicit.

recommended_next_step: Correct the Cook--Mishler--Ramdas bibliographic citation, then advance this field-tier novelty kernel to Stage 0.
